info.name: ATUPA LMS API
info.description:
End-to-end collection for the ATUPA LMS backend.

1. Import the collection and an environment (Local or Render).
2. Set `adminEmail` / `adminPassword` in the environment to the server's SUPER_ADMIN_* values.
3. Run the whole collection (Runner) or go folder by folder. Requests save tokens and ids in collection variables for later requests. A new `runId` per run keeps emails unique.

Folder 08 assumes the seeded demo course (SEED_DEMO_CONTENT=true).
